title: Grade 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — General Assessment #14

pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these describes healthy eating? (1 mark)
   A. Never drinking water
   B. Eating rotten food
   C. Eating only sweets
   D. Eating fruits, vegetables and whole grains

2. Which of these is a plant that has a thick main root with thin side roots? (1 mark)
   A. Bean plant
   B. Wheat
   C. Maize
   D. Grass

3. Which of these do we drink to keep digestion healthy? (1 mark)
   A. Clean safe water
   B. Sugary drinks all the time
   C. Muddy water
   D. Nothing

4. Which of these holds a shirt together? (1 mark)
   A. Wind
   B. Thread stitches
   C. Oil
   D. A rolling wheel

5. Which of these animals lays eggs? (1 mark)
   A. Cow
   B. Hen
   C. Human
   D. Goat

6. Which of these is a crab? (1 mark)
   A. A vertebrate with fur
   B. A bird
   C. A mammal
   D. An invertebrate with a hard outer shell

7. Which of these is a mammal that lives in water? (1 mark)
   A. Whale
   B. Tilapia
   C. Crocodile
   D. Frog

8. What is matter? (1 mark)
   A. Anything that has mass and takes up space
   B. Anything that makes sound
   C. Anything that is hot
   D. Anything that shines

9. What does a mother hen do for her chicks? (1 mark)
   A. Feeds them iron
   B. Makes them wet
   C. Cools them
   D. Keeps them warm under her wings

10. Which of these animals has an outside skeleton or hard covering and no backbone? (1 mark)
   A. Tilapia
   B. Hen
   C. Goat
   D. Crab

11. Who should monitor taps in a school? (1 mark)
   A. Water monitors
   B. Only cooks
   C. Only visitors
   D. Nobody

12. Which of these uses of light is for plants? (1 mark)
   A. Making them bend downward
   B. Making their own food
   C. Making roots taller
   D. Making them cold

13. Which of these is translucent? (1 mark)
   A. Wood
   B. Tissue paper
   C. Stone
   D. Clear glass

14. Why is a plan for a healthy digestive system useful? (1 mark)
   A. It makes us grow overnight
   B. It cures all diseases at once
   C. It stops us feeling hungry
   D. It reminds us to do the right things every day

15. Why should a rainwater tank be covered? (1 mark)
   A. To keep out mosquitoes and dirt
   B. To make it rain
   C. To keep the water warm
   D. To make water heavier

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain what would happen to a young bean plant if all its leaves were removed and why. (4 marks)

17. Describe safety measures to be observed when handling heat at home and at school. (5 marks)

18. Give two examples of decomposable waste and two of non-decomposable waste. (2 marks)

19. Name the part of a plant that makes food and the part that makes seeds. (2 marks)

20. Convert 3 litres into millilitres. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Eating fruits, vegetables and whole grains
   Healthy eating includes fibre and a variety of foods.

2. A — Bean plant
   A bean plant has a main root with side roots. Maize and grass have many thin roots.

3. A — Clean safe water
   Clean safe water helps digestion and prevents disease.

4. B — Thread stitches
   Stitches hold cloth pieces together.

5. B — Hen
   A hen lays eggs. The others give birth to live young.

6. D — An invertebrate with a hard outer shell
   A crab has no backbone and has a hard shell outside.

7. A — Whale
   A whale breathes air and feeds milk to its calf, so it is a mammal even though it lives in water.

8. A — Anything that has mass and takes up space
   Matter has mass and occupies space.

9. D — Keeps them warm under her wings
   Chicks need warmth.

10. D — Crab
   A crab has a hard outer shell and no backbone.

11. A — Water monitors
   Monitors help make sure taps are closed.

12. B — Making their own food
   Plants use light to make food.

13. B — Tissue paper
   Tissue paper lets some light through.

14. D — It reminds us to do the right things every day
   A plan helps us follow healthy habits.

15. A — To keep out mosquitoes and dirt
   A cover stops mosquitoes breeding and dirt getting in.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: The plant would become weak and stop growing. Leaves make food for the plant. Roots can take in water but without leaves the plant cannot make enough food.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for weak or stops growing, 1 mark for leaves make food, 1 mark for no food made, 1 mark for roots alone are not enough.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: Do not play with matches, keep children from fires, use gloves, turn handles inwards, switch off cookers and irons, keep fuels away from fire, cool burns with water and tell an adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each measure up to 5.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Decomposable: vegetable peelings, dung, leaves. Non-decomposable: plastic, tin, glass.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Leaves make food and flowers (fruits) make seeds.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct part.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: 3000 ml.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 3 x 1000 and 1 mark for the answer.
